name: smwmusic-a-super-mario-thing-the-wonders-of-ice-ice-world
title: A Super Mario Thing - The Wonders of Ice ~ Ice World
description:
This remix is very much inspired by the remix as heard in this variation of the theme. I added percussion, resampled instruments, and an added tempo effect before it loops.

Omits @7, @12, @15 and Thunder.brr, so no yoshies/thunder/blarggs/whatnot and no P-switch/Bonus End.

Credit mainly goes to prsnth1111.
